text:
Priya: Quick design check — thinking about changing the latency chart: legend placement, axis labels (ms vs s), smoothing, handling spikes. Thoughts?
Zara: Right now legend on right looks cramped on narrow screens. Top inline legend might be better.
Eli: Top legend helps mobile but eats vertical space. Could collapse to a dropdown when screen < 800px.
Asha: Can we keep full metric names? "p90 latency (ms)" vs shorthand "p90 (ms)" — accessibility/readability tradeoff.
Marco: For cost charts we use dollars with units k/M etc. Could we auto-scale units for latency too? e.g., show s if >1000ms.
Zara: I prefer explicit unit label on axis: "Latency (ms)" but switch to "Latency (s)" when converted. Avoid mixing units in axis ticks.
Eli: Also propose log scale option for tail-heavy latency to avoid smoothing hiding spikes.
Priya: About smoothing — we use 3-point moving average now; team worried it hides real regressions.
Marco: Maybe offer both: raw faint line + smoothed bold line. That preserves spikes and makes trends visible.
Zara: +1. Visual weight helps. Also legend should include a small key showing "Raw" vs "Smoothed".
Asha: Accessibility: color palette must be colorblind-safe. Also add patterns/dash styles for line types so screen readers and monochrome prints work.
Eli: Tooltip content should include exact timestamp and raw value. We should avoid truncating numbers in tooltip.
Priya: Copy tweak: change "p90" label to "90th percentile (p90)" for clarity across audiences.
Zara: Outlier handling: cap y-axis with "Show outliers" toggle. Default to "show" but allow cap at 99.9th percentile for stable view.
Marco: For performance dashboards we also need a "zoom to spike" CTA that filters to that time window.
chartbot: Deploy check — charting PR #782 landed on staging with top legend and raw+smoothed lines. Preview: https://staging.redwood.dev/charts/PR-782
Asha: I'll review staging shortly. If everyone's OK, merge after accessibility color check.
Eli: I'll add a11y contrast tests and a mobile legend collapse.
Zara: I'll update the mock in Figma and post before EOD :paintbrush:
Priya: Great — thanks all. Action items: Zara updates mocks, Eli adds mobile collapse + a11y tests, Marco adds raw+smoothed toggle. I'll follow up on copy change.
Asha: assigning follow-ups in Asana.
